mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day returns. The current FEDFUNDS level of 1.98% is below the long-term average, signaling an easing monetary policy that supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day returns. The current UNRATE of 5.5% is rising, activating the signal.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a negative real rate environment when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.0%, which is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day returns due to inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion. The current FEDFUNDS level of 1.98% is rising, activating the signal.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: A low level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates weak demand for residential construction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 20-day returns. The current HOUST value of 1032.0 is below the long-term average, signaling a deteriorating housing market.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1050.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day returns. The current INDPRO value of 111.18 is near the threshold, and a drop below 110 would activate the signal.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a severe economic contraction when INDPRO falls below 110 and HOUST falls below 1000, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110 AND HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: During a demand contraction (defined as RSAFS falling for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns due to reduced consumer and business spending. The current RSAFS value of 385448.0 is declining, activating the signal.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during demand contractions (RSAFS falling for 3 consecutive months).
